expectedOutcome: Different commit counts do not trigger a branch transfer when exact trees and aggregate patches are identical.
injectedEvent: A reviewer treats eight branch-only commits and one main-only commit as proof of unique committed content.
invariants: Commit topology and tree identity remain separate claims.
Exact tree equality outranks commit-count intuition for current content.
Dirty work remains a separate approval-gated candidate set.
firstPass: Reject commit-count-only reasoning and compare final trees plus aggregate patches.
reviewPass: Recheck live remote heads, tree IDs, changed paths, aggregate patch IDs, and dirty work independently.
reconciledResult: No committed branch transfer is needed; only dirty durable candidates remain for later approved sanitation and transfer.
assumptions: Live remote main and gh-pages heads match local tracking objects during capture.
uncertainty: Individual commit patch IDs differ because one history is squashed; this does not imply a final-tree difference.
repairRoute: If remote heads drift or tree hashes differ, mark this evidence stale and recapture without fetching inside this leaf.
